headline: Old business, new business, public comment, and a correspondence summary are on the agenda.
summary: The agenda lists old and new business, a summary of recent correspondence, and an executive session if the town attorney recommends one. Public comment is also on the agenda, with three minutes allowed per speaker.
items: Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
FARMINGTON CANAL 
COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
7:00 PM, NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Farmington Canal Commission, Town of Hamden, will hold a 
Regular Meeting on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 7:00 PM via Zoom only. 
 
Comments for this meeting can be made by joining the meeting and participating in the 
public input session. You will have 3 minutes to speak. Or you can write in and send them 
to HBC_FarmingtonCanal@Hamden.com. 
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: https://hamden.zoom.us/j/81631450727 
 
Meeting ID: 816 3145 0727 
 
Dial In:  +1 646.558.8656 US (New York)  
Participants without Zoom access may still be able to join the meeting (in listen-only mode) 
by (1) dialing the above number and (2) entering the meeting ID: 816 3145 0727 (3) 
followed by #.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
7. REPORTS
1. Report of the Chairman 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
